description: A51: habit.delete on the wire. The accepted ack; a stale base_version (version_conflict with the current habit); a log write to a deleted habit (conflict resource_deleted naming the habit, the ack keeping the log's own id); the journal changes one delete produces (each removed log and reminder, then the habit); and the habit tombstone as a pulled change (deleted_at set, name empty, no unit, no definitions or ranges).

error.message: This habit was deleted on another device.

rules: habit.delete is allowed from active or archived; repeated, it is acknowledged with no change
removed with the habit: its logs (with notes), reminders, definition versions, active ranges, streak cache and period evaluations
kept: xp_entitlements, xp_ledger, freeze_usage, freeze_ledger and reward_state; the level never drops because of a delete

every log.* write and reminder.create on a deleted habit is conflict resource_deleted with entity habit and no resource_id; habit.update, habit.archive and habit.restore are conflict resource_deleted naming the habit
